title: no_focused_window — no focused window, screen structure unreadable (null root)

keywords: null root node returned by UiTestAutomationBridge

symptom: app tree · app tap --text · waits in app run fail, and uiautomator dump prints 'ERROR: null root node returned by UiTestAutomationBridge.'. The home screen seems to be showing
cause: Android has no window with focus (mCurrentFocus=null in dumpsys window). Happens right after a reboot, with the screen off, locked, or mid-transition (measured: 5 times in a row after an emulator soft reboot)
fix: The CLI already wakes the screen (WAKEUP · unlock) and reads up to three times before returning this code. Call app tree once more after a few seconds
Look at the current screen with app shot. If it is a password lock screen, ask the user to unlock it
If it persists, check with adb -s <serial> shell dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus whether a focused window appeared
